meta.name: histone-aggregation
meta.description: Build comprehensive histone mark maps by aggregating narrowPeak data across multiple ENCODE experiments, donors, and labs. Use when the user wants to answer "where is this histone mark present in my tissue?" by combining peak calls from multiple studies into a union peak set with confidence annotations. Handles cross-lab batch effects, broad vs narrow marks, and ENCODE blocklist filtering.

copy.tagline: 整合多个实验的组蛋白修饰数据，生成高置信度峰图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个样本中定位组蛋白修饰的分布
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate histone mark peaks from multiple ENCODE experiments into a confident union set
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to locate histone mark presence across multiple samples and studies

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 该技能会搜索并整合多个ENCODE实验的组蛋白ChIP-seq峰数据，生成一个合并的峰集，并标注每个峰在多少样本中出现，从而回答特定组织或细胞类型中某个组蛋白修饰的存在位置。
howto.when: 当用户询问某个组蛋白修饰在特定组织中的位置，或要求合并多个实验的峰数据时触发。例如：“H3K27ac在胰腺中在哪里？”或“构建肝脏的组蛋白标记图谱”。

say.text: 请帮我整合胰腺中H3K27ac的所有峰数据。
say.note: 技能会搜索并合并ENCODE实验，生成带置信度标注的峰集。

say.text: 构建大脑的H3K4me3组蛋白标记图谱。
say.note: 技能会聚合多个供体的峰数据，输出合并峰集。

howto.what_en: This skill searches and integrates histone ChIP-seq peak data from multiple ENCODE experiments, merging them into a union peak set with confidence annotations (number of supporting samples) to answer where a histone mark is present in a specific tissue or cell type.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about the location of a histone mark in a specific tissue, or requests aggregation of peak data across multiple experiments. Example: 'Where is H3K27ac in pancreas?' or 'Build a histone mark map for liver.'

say_en.text: Aggregate all H3K27ac peaks in pancreas.
Build a histone mark map for H3K4me3 in brain.
say_en.note: Skill will combine peaks from multiple donors and labs into a consensus map.
